title: Soviet Horten-based flying saucer program

tellings.quote: programs and it was revealed when the after the Soviet Union fell some of this documentation became available was to to build a kind of flying saucer and it was based on the Horton model.

plain: After 1945 the Soviet Union ran a programme to build a kind of flying saucer, based on the designs of the Horten brothers, two German aircraft designers of the Second World War, according to the author Peter Levenda. He tells Michels that this came out once the Soviet Union fell and some of its documents became available, though he does not name the documents. The claim would mean that the Soviets, too, tried to build disc-shaped craft from German wartime work.
